name: Gatherer
why: Feeds the founding band before farming exists.

name: Farmer
why: Turns a camp into a village. Rain and drought hit farmers first.

name: Fisher
why: Learns currents and boats. Most voyages start with a fisher.

name: Builder
why: Shelter raises births. Walls only go up under threat.

name: Leader
why: Moves people toward the biggest need. Declares war or marries into peace.

name: Sky-speaker
why: Explains your weather. Faith refills your divine energy.

name: Warrior
why: Protects the village but does not farm.

name: Boatwright
why: The key to the Far Shore.
